rule: one HS6 code per material: its main traded form (refined/unwrought metal or ferro-alloy for metals, crude mineral for industrial minerals), the same rule as the original 32
trade: CEPII BACI HS17 V202601, year 2024, top exporter by US$ value
mine: top producer, 2024: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (latest edition) where held, else World Mining Data, else BGS World Mineral Statistics

bismuth.form: bismuth (single heading, includes articles and scrap)

perlite_vermiculite.form: vermiculite, perlite, chlorites, unexpanded (one code, one material)

bromine.form: bromine (shares the code with fluorine, whose trade is negligible)

excluded.tellurium: shares HS 280450 with boron; cannot be separated
excluded.uranium: 46 trade records in 2024; most uranium trade is confidential
excluded.fuels: crude oil, natural gas, steam coal, lignite: out of this pass by decision, may be added as their own section
